name: zz-admin-roster-abilities
description: Open admin panel, load a user, and verify the roster shows abilities plus the Scan/Repair Roster controls

steps.expression: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid=debug-input]'); if (!el) return 'ERR: no debug input'; if (el.value !== 'admin') { const set = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; set.call(el, 'admin'); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); } el.focus(); el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', code: 'Enter', keyCode: 13, which: 13, bubbles: true })); return 'submitted'; })()
steps.name: submit admin command

steps.expression: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'User'); if (b) { b.click(); return 'clicked User tab'; } return 'User tab not found'; })()
steps.name: open Users tab

steps.expression: (() => { const chips = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).filter(b => b.textContent.trim().startsWith('u/')); if (!chips.length) return 'ERR: no username chips'; const names = chips.map(c => c.textContent.trim()); const pick = chips.find(c => /carol/i.test(c.textContent)) || chips[0]; pick.click(); return 'clicked ' + pick.textContent.trim() + ' of ' + JSON.stringify(names); })()
steps.name: pick first username

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).map(b => b.textContent.trim()); const body = document.body.innerText; return JSON.stringify({ hasScan: btns.includes('Scan Roster'), hasRepair: btns.includes('Repair Roster'), hasClamp: /clamp stats/.test(body), rosterHeading: (body.match(/Roster \([^)]*\)/) || [])[0] || null, abilityCells: Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('td[colspan="8"]')).map(td => td.innerText.trim()).slice(0, 8) }); })()
steps.name: repair controls + ability rows
